Out-of-pocket limit exclusions include 'prescription drugs' but drug coverage details show co-pays/co-insurance, creating potential confusion about what counts toward limit
Excluded services list states 'This isn't a complete list. Check your policy for others.' creating uncertainty about full scope of exclusions
Other covered services list states 'This isn't a complete list. Check your policy for other covered services' creating uncertainty about full scope of coverage
Coverage examples explicitly state they are 'not a cost estimator' and 'not for estimating actual costs', limiting their utility for precise cost prediction
